# Requirement gate

Use `forge-requirement` for an independent, read-only analysis of the user's request and relevant workspace. Cover intake, gaps, critique, architecture alternatives, QA strategy, and self-challenge. Identify BIZ and REQ candidates, testable acceptance criteria, risks, assumptions, decisions, and candidate tests. Label findings by severity and distinguish sourced facts from assumptions. Never invent evidence or silently discard critical or high findings.

Review the specialist report independently. Resolve material blockers with the user; label safe defaults and their rationale. Submit the requirement baseline, findings, blockers, assumptions, and relevant files through `forge_requirement_summary` before planning. Do not implement or claim approval.
